messages.author: c2165ee4b087e079
messages.subject: Topicmodels not supported by ShinyApps?
parts:
Hi,

Is the package topicmodels not supported by the current build of ShinyApps?

I get the following error message when deploying my app to Shiny server:

Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 543319 failed: Error building image: Error building topicmodels (0.2-1). Build exited with non-zero status: 1


Thanks in advance!
